Text A. Bring clothes you no longer wear to our Saturday morning meeting in the cafeteria. Exchange them for other clothes without paying. We take shirts, jeans and jumpers, but not shoes. A parent must come with each child.

Text B. Our school has costumes for plays. You can borrow a costume for one week without paying. Come after school on Tuesday. A teacher helps you choose the right size. Please return everything clean.

Text C. Do not throw away a jacket because a pocket has a hole. On Wednesday afternoons, learn to repair clothes with us. Bring one piece of clothing to work on. Our teacher provides the tools. Children can come without a parent.
